name: metr_point_v0_attention_confidence
rationale: The conditioning spatial attention has two relatively sharp heads, 2 and 4, with normalized entropy 0.434 and 0.432. For missing queries, head 2 assigns 85.0% of attention to observed sources, versus 74.3% for head 4 (67.6% available). Reallocate a small amount of their readout strength: increase head 2's output-projection columns by 10% and decrease head 4's by 10%. Q/K/V parameters and all other heads remain fixed. Head selection comes from observed-source attention statistics on calibration inputs, not error gradients. Confirm any accuracy gain independently.
